1513601.name: Violet Torrent
1513601.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1513602.name: Rushing Streams
1513602.description: Fires a beam, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1513603.name: Tears of Silence
1513603.description: Shoots water droplets, dealing damage to Nikkes. Any Nikkes who are hit will be temporarily unable to use their Burst Skills. The droplets can be intercepted.

1513604.name: Approaching Horizon
1513604.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1513605.name: Surging Ripple
1513605.description: Discharges an energy wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1513607.name: Calm Horizon
1513607.description:
Fires laser beams from its weapon, dealing massive damage to multiple Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while Cancel Rings are active. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1513611.name: Silent Judgment
1513611.description: Gathers up water before discharging it in a torrent, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Any Nikkes who are hit will be temporarily unable to use their Burst Skills.

1513612.name: Ascending Waterfall
1513612.description: Generates pillars of water, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1513616.name: Abyssal Veil
1513616.description: Deploys an Abyssal Veil, increasing its defense rate.
